classification.family:
The cognation judgments involving Damal in **hh:hvw:Larson:Irian-Highlands** are
overly optimistic in that a match is judged if at least one segment matches.
This procedure yields inconsistent sound correspondences. The lexicostatistic
argument for relatedness is the only one offered so far, and apart from probable
borrowings, we cannot find any cognates in vocabulary or morphology.
